?? Location: Bowhill, SA 
?? Employment Type: Full-Time 

Let your skills & strength shine Admin / HR / WHSE 
Bowhill Engineering is growing, and we're looking for capable, organised and proactive people to join our team to support Admin, HR & WHSE. 
You may come from an Administration background, have experience in Human Resources, be passionate about Workplace Health & Safety, or bring a combination of all three. What matters most is your ability to keep things organised, support our people, and help our business operate efficiently. 
We have opportunities across Administration, HR and WHSE functions, with responsibilities tailored to suit the skills and experience of the successful applicants. 
Whether you're looking to broaden your career, develop new skills, or bring your existing expertise into a supportive environment, we'd love to hear from you. 

About the Role 
In any of these roles, you'll become an important part of our team, providing administrative and operational support across a range of business functions. 

Depending on your experience and interests, your responsibilities may include: 
Administration Support 
-Reception and general office administration
-Calendar and appointment coordination
-Document preparation and record management
*Support the business wholistically with administration requirements
-Plan, prep and coordinate employee & visitor engagement activities & events 

Human Resources Support 
-Payroll processing assistance and backup
-Recruitment and onboarding coordination
-Employee records administration
-Performance appraisal coordination
-Employee recognition and wellbeing initiatives 

WHSE Support 
-Maintaining safety and compliance records
-Coordinating training and inductions
-Supporting audits, inspections and corrective actions
-Assisting with incident reporting and investigations
-Return-to-work and rehabilitation administration 
Full training and support will be provided, and the roles can evolve based on the successful candidate's strengths and career aspirations. 

What We're Looking For 
You don't need experience in all areas. We're interested in people who: 
? Are highly organised and detail-oriented 
? Enjoy helping others and supporting teams 
? Communicate professionally and confidently 
? Take initiative and ownership of their work 
? Can manage multiple priorities effectively 
? Have strong computer and administrative skills 
? Bring a positive, solutions-focused attitude 

Experience That Would Be Valuable 
-Business Administration
-Human Resources
-Payroll or Recruitment
-WHSE, Compliance or Training Administration
-Microsoft Office Suite (Word, Excel, Outlook, PowerPoint) 

Relevant qualifications or a willingness to undertake further training will be highly regarded. 

Why Join Bowhill Engineering? 
At Bowhill Engineering, we're proud of the culture we've built. We're a team that values people, growth, accountability and continuous improvement. 

Employee Benefits Include: 
-Employee Assistance Program (EAP)
-Health & Wellbeing Support
-Reward & Recognition Programs
-Social Events & Team Activities
-Career Development & Training Opportunities
-Modern Workplace Facilities 
-Supportive Team Environment 

What You'll Love 
-Variety and flexibility in your role
-Opportunities to learn and develop new skills
-Making a genuine impact across the business
-Working with a team that values your contribution 

Ready to Apply? 
If you're an organised, motivated person looking for a rewarding role where you can make a real difference, we'd love to hear from you.

MedicalJobsAustralia.com     Your Role as Engagement Officer

The Engagement Officer plays a vital role in connecting passionate community members with meaningful volunteer opportunities across Wesley Mission Queensland. As the central point for volunteer recruitment and onboarding, this position is responsible for delivering the end-to-end recruitment and placement process while ensuring all compliance requirements are met.

Working collaboratively with service leaders and community stakeholders, the Engagement Officer builds strong volunteer pipelines, supports successful volunteer integration, and contributes to a positive and engaging volunteer experience that strengthens our services and communities.

Key responsibilities include:

Managing the end-to-end recruitment, selection, onboarding and placement of volunteers across Wesley Mission Queensland services.

Developing and implementing targeted volunteer attraction campaigns across digital platforms, community networks and events.

Partnering with service leaders to identify volunteer needs and develop clear, engaging volunteer position descriptions.

Conducting volunteer screening, interviews, reference checks and ensuring all onboarding compliance requirements are completed.

Acting as the central point of contact for prospective volunteers, providing professional guidance and support throughout the recruitment journey.

Maintaining accurate volunteer records across CRM, Volunteer Management Systems and other organisational platforms.

Monitoring recruitment activity and reporting on volunteer pipelines, placement outcomes and recruitment effectiveness.

Supporting volunteer recognition initiatives and representing Volunteer Relations at internal and external engagement events.

Building and maintaining strong relationships with internal stakeholders to ensure successful volunteer placements and ongoing collaboration.

Assisting with additional duties as directed by the Engagement Coordinator or Team Leader.

This is a part-time position consisting of 24 hours per week.

What We Offer

Community-Focused Team Culture: Be part of a passionate team that values connection, collaboration, and making a genuine difference in people's lives every day.

Salary Packaging: As a not-for-profit employee, you can package up to $15,900 each year on everyday living expenses and up to $2,650 on meals and entertainment reducing your taxable income and giving you more in your pocket.

Flexibility and Balance: We can offer a range of flexible work options to help you achieve the balance that works for you.

Free and Secure Car Parking: No more paid parking! Employees can enjoy complimentary access to secure parking, ensuring the safety of their vehicles while at work

What We're Looking For

Understanding of the non-profit sector and the operational requirements of delivering volunteer services in diverse community settings.

Experience in end-to-end recruitment, including multi-channel sourcing, candidate screening and values-aligned interviewing.

Ability to work effectively within a collaborative team environment to achieve high-performance outcomes.

Strong interpersonal skills with the ability to build positive relationships with a broad range of internal and external stakeholders.

Proficiency in drafting targeted marketing content, position descriptions, general correspondence and related documentation.

High-level accuracy in data entry and documentation, ensuring meticulous record-keeping and regulatory compliance.

Experience using CRM platforms, Volunteer Management Systems, Learning Management Systems or similar systems for data management and activity tracking.
